idea: Colors (Friday school readiness, long ~2:40 learning song) in the BACKYARD (Ava in HOME outfit): a little RED butterfly flutters down right beside Baby Ava's cheek ('Wow! Look! A red butterfly!'); chorus 'Flutter, flutter, butterflies! Red and yellow, blue and green! … The prettiest colors I have seen!'; one butterfly per verse lands by her – RED (say it with me + flap your arms like wings), YELLOW (yellow like the sun + wiggle your fingers), BLUE (blue like the sky + clap your hands), GREEN (green like the grass + bounce); clap break; review – the four butterflies in a neat row: 'Red, yellow, blue and green! Four butterflies! Which one is blue? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'The blue one! Yay!'; final chorus with all four butterflies dancing around her; loop: the hook framing with the red butterfly, 'Bye bye, friends! Bye bye, butterflies!'.
title: Wow! A Red Butterfly! 🦋 Colors Song with Baby Ava | Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A little red butterfly flutters down right beside Baby Ava! 🦋 Sing along with Baby Ava in her sunny backyard and learn four colors – red, yellow, blue and green – as a new butterfly comes to say hello in every verse.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! A red butterfly!"
🔴 Red, red, red! Flap your arms like wings with Ava!
🟡 Yellow like the sun – wiggle your fingers!
🔵 Blue like the sky – clap your hands!
🟢 Green like the grass – bounce, bounce, bounce!
👏 Clap break – clap and flap with Ava!
🤔 "Which one is blue?" – can you find it?
👋 Bye bye, friends! Bye bye, butterflies!

📚 Kids learn: the colors red, yellow, blue and green • matching colors to things they know (yellow sun, blue sky, green grass) • finding a color when asked • English words: butterfly, flutter, wings, sun, sky, grass

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

🎵 Lyrics (chorus):
Flutter, flutter, butterflies!
Red and yellow, blue and green!
Flutter, flutter, butterflies!
The prettiest colors I have seen!

A fun sing-along colors song for toddlers and preschoolers – learn red, yellow, blue and green with Baby Ava and four friendly butterflies, then flap, wiggle, clap and bounce along. A cappella children's song with voices, claps and a hand drum.
